result.title: PCGRL for Complex Platformers: Synthesizing Playable and Diverse Levels via Inflated Envelopes and Forward Curricula
result.summary: Procedural Content Generation via Reinforcement Learning (PCGRL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for automated game development. However, existing PCGRL frameworks still suffer from severe exploration bottlenecks and scaling limitations when faced with long-sequence generation tasks governed by strict rigid-body rules and non-linear kinematic boundaries (e.g., platformer constraints). Consequently, traditional approaches frequently fail to maintain reliable level solvability on large-scale canvases. To address these challenges, we present a physics-aware, curriculum-guided PCGRL framework. First, we construct an "Inflated Volume Envelope" mechanism, which provides a physics-constrained representation that incorporates continuous kinematic feasibility into the discrete state space of the MDP. Second, to alleviate the sparse reward challenge induced by extremely long decision sequences, we introduce intermediate state-transition feedback and a multi-stage forward extension curriculum learning framework, enabling informative value estimation and stable credit assignment over long-horizon trajectories. Finally, to resolve the issue where deterministic policies after convergence generate highly monotonous map paths with a lack of diversity, we activate high-entropy stochastic inference during the synthesis phase, regularized by a post-hoc parallel rejection filtering mechanism. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework significantly enhances structural diversity while maintaining high physical playability across multi-scale environments. Comparative evaluations across multi-scale canvases demonstrate that our framework maintains superior convergence stability and dimensional scalability, reliably synthesizing solvable levels where traditional PCGRL baselines degrade.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一个物理感知、课程引导的 PCGRL 框架，用「Inflated Volume Envelope」把连续运动学可行性嵌入离散 MDP 状态空间，并用中间状态转移反馈、多阶段前向课程与高熵采样加事后并行拒绝过滤，在长序列平台关卡生成中兼顾可解性与多样性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把几何/运动学可行约束注入离散状态表示、以及长决策序列上的中间反馈与课程式信用分配，可能为 LVR 中「几何与任务必要信息如何留在内部状态」及长轨迹贡献分配提供可核查线索；高熵采样加拒绝过滤亦与生成后验证和停止决策相关，但需判断能否迁移到多模态 latent 推理。
